known_issues: Stable loop live mode still depends on underlying task/work-cycle safety gates; use preview records before live execution.
Approved task execution routes through run_command approvals and command_runner safety checks, so command whitelist failures can still block approval execution.
Approval-gated task execution now creates approval records, but the dashboard lifecycle wording still needs polish.
Canonical task/work state is data/tasks.json; work_queue files and routes are compatibility aliases until cleanup finishes.
Legacy /work-queue and /api/work-queue names still exist as compatibility aliases; new dashboard/API usage should prefer /tasks-work and /api/tasks/...
Numeric work priority maps onto canonical task priority labels, so old work CLI priority display can look different after conversion.
Local AI features depend on Ollama being reachable and the configured models being installed.
Onboarding recommends commands but does not yet provide one-click clipboard helpers for copying them.
Onboarding can guide service startup, but starting dashboard/API still happens through existing desktop/dashboard controls.
Real tray support requires optional pystray and Pillow dependencies; watcher mode remains the dependency-free fallback.
Desktop shell currently provides launcher/status/chat controls, not full tray integration.
Desktop companion requires Tkinter to be available in the local Python install.
Browser live polling depends on the dashboard-integrated local API being reachable.
Live refresh updates counts and status text, but full table rows still require a page reload.
Dashboard forms currently support creation, not full edit/delete CRUD for every item.
API is intentionally local-only by default and has no authentication layer for public exposure.
Chat-to-action currently uses deterministic intent matching rather than full local-AI intent parsing
Local model quality depends on the Ollama model installed
Applied patches require manual testing
Rollback blocks if files changed after apply, requiring manual recovery if needed
Command runner is whitelist-only and does not yet summarize test results automatically
No automatic keep-or-rollback recommendation after command execution yet
Test-runner workflow does not yet auto-rollback; rollback still requires explicit command
Test recommendations are rule-based and not yet deeply AI-analyzed
No automatic post-patch AI review of command output yet
Auto-review is advisory only and does not rollback automatically
AI review quality depends on the local Ollama model installed
Long patch/run/report ids are annoying to copy manually
Maintenance suggestions are advisory only and do not run commands or apply changes
No memory compaction/summarization workflow yet
Goals were previously loose strings in self_model.json and project metadata
Task execution is supervised and whitelist-only; it does not grant unrestricted terminal access
Task execution can run approved commands but does not decide automatically what to run without user command
Guided work sessions still advance only one step at a time and do not provide full autopilot
Approval inbox is explicit and supervised; it does not grant automatic permission to apply or rollback patches.
Settings changes do not bypass safety gates; file edits and rollbacks still require approval workflows.
Watch mode is advisory and does not apply patches, rollback files, approve actions, or run unsafe commands automatically.
Watch loops are bounded and stop when attention is needed instead of running forever.
Dashboard chat console still depends on local Ollama for conversational responses when enabled.

notes: v11.0 rollback now fails fast if latest_apply_report.json is stale or points to a dry-run/non-applied report.
v11.0 stores the Eidolon workspace root as . and resolves it from ROOT_DIR, avoiding stale sandbox paths after unzipping.
v11.0 added workspace_orchestration.py for project registry, health, command profiles, dependency map, task inbox, context bundles, timeline, and workspace dev-loop preview.
v6.8 added stable_loop_followup_completion.py, follow-up closure reports/filters/cleanup, and fixed dashboard /api-info routing by matching only /api or /api/... as API routes.
v4.2 added desktop quick-action buttons for diagnostics, watch, maintenance scans, session planning, dev-loop dry-runs, and attention summaries.
v4.2 added desktop notification actions for showing unread notes, opening latest notes, marking read, dismissing, clearing dismissed records, and dry-running latest pending approvals.
v4.2 added /api/desktop/attention, /api/maintenance, and /api/dev-loops routes for desktop-friendly local control.
v4.4 added desktop_setup_helper.py, setup reports, CLI setup check commands, dashboard /setup, API /api/setup routes, setup counts in /api/status, and desktop setup quick actions.
v4.4 setup checks are advisory and do not install packages, edit settings automatically, or bypass existing safety gates.
v5.3.1 refreshed version labels, settings schema value, health-check notes, project next steps, and task-centered troubleshooting guidance.
v5.6 added task_lifecycle.py to derive readable task lifecycle stages from canonical task state, approvals, and patch metadata.
v5.6 dashboard/API now expose lifecycle summaries through /tasks-work, /api/tasks/lifecycle, and /api/tasks/{id}/lifecycle.
v5.9 adds lifecycle-aware work-cycle decisions through task_cycle_policy.py and records lifecycle decisions in saved work-cycle records.
v6.6 added stable_loop_followup_tasks.py to create canonical task-backed follow-ups from stable-loop final decisions.
v6.7 added stable_loop_followup_lifecycle.py and task lifecycle fields so decision-created follow-up tasks point back to their stable-loop source decision.
v6.7 dashboard/API/CLI can resolve a stable-loop decision follow-up chain once linked follow-up tasks are done and can optionally archive the source stable-loop record.
